weekly_digest.period_label: 近 7 日全球 AI 大事周报（截至 2026-11-19）
weekly_digest.summary: 本周共收录 21 项国内外 AI 关键进展（海外 10 · 国内 5 · 开源生态 14）。主线聚焦三大方向：1）中美头部旗舰模型进入新一轮迭代与商业化验证；2）端侧中小参数与开源推理引擎持续拉低个人电脑本地运行门槛；3）多模态世界模型与编程 Agent 加速落地真实开发工作流。
weekly_digest.summary_en: Tracked 21 AI milestones this week (10 global, 5 China, 14 open-source). Key themes: flagship model competition, local/edge open-weight breakthroughs, and multimodal & coding agents entering production.

highlights.title: Google 更新开源模型「DiffusionGemma」与世界模型「Project Genie 4」
highlights.title_en: Google updates open-weight DiffusionGemma & Project Genie 4 world model
highlights.what_it_does: DiffusionGemma 用并行扩散机制大幅加快本地文字生成；Project Genie 4 能根据一句话生成可实时操作游玩的 3D 交互世界，用于游戏原型与机器人仿真。
highlights.what_it_does_en: DiffusionGemma speeds up local generation via diffusion; Genie 4 creates interactive 3D worlds for simulation and games.
highlights.who_cares: 端侧 AI 开发者、游戏与机器人仿真团队
highlights.limitations: Project Genie 4 仍为研究预览，未开放本地权重下载。
highlights.limitations_en: Genie 4 remains a gated research preview without open weights.

highlights.title: 腾讯混元「Hy4 Flash」首日调用量突破 50 万亿，赋能海内外视频工具
highlights.title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 Flash tops 50T first-day calls powering global video tools
highlights.what_it_does: 高速低成本轻量模型，专门用来支撑高并发实时对话、内容批量摘要以及海内外 AI 短视频工具的脚本/画面生产。
highlights.what_it_does_en: High-throughput, low-latency model built for real-time apps and batch video creation workflows.
highlights.who_cares: 国内开发者、SaaS 与出海视频应用团队
highlights.limitations: 受算力供给约束，下一代超大参数混元旗舰存在延期压力。
highlights.limitations_en: Compute supply bottlenecks may pace the next ultra-large Hunyuan release.

highlights.title: OpenAI 联手 AMD 用大模型加速下一代芯片设计，并持续迭代图像多模态
highlights.title_en: OpenAI partners with AMD on LLM-accelerated chip design alongside multimodal updates
highlights.what_it_does: 用 AI 自动辅助芯片验证和底层架构优化，缩短新算力卡上市周期并拉低未来 AI 推理算力成本。
highlights.what_it_does_en: Uses LLMs to speed up hardware design verification and reduce future AI inference costs.
highlights.who_cares: 芯片产业链观察者与 AI 行业从业者
highlights.limitations: 属中长期底层算力合作，短期内不会立刻体现在普通聊天产品界面上。
highlights.limitations_en: Medium-to-long-term R&D milestone without immediate consumer UI changes.

highlights.title: 千问上线下一代旗舰预览版「Qwen4-Max-Preview」
highlights.title_en: Alibaba Qwen launches next-gen flagship Qwen4-Max-Preview
highlights.what_it_does: 中文语境理解、复杂数学逻辑推理与工具调用全面升级，适合国内企业和个人平替昂贵海外模型做知识库与 Agent 办公。
highlights.what_it_does_en: Upgraded bilingual reasoning, math, and tool-use built for enterprise agents and knowledge bases.
highlights.who_cares: 国内开发者、企业团队、高频办公人群
highlights.limitations: 目前以阿里云云端 API 预览为主，完整开源及正式计费待公布。
highlights.limitations_en: Currently cloud API preview; full GA pricing and open-weight plans pending.
